verdict.rationale: Evidence covers expense management, bill pay, cards, and AI features, but no documentation addresses reimbursing employees abroad in local currency without a separate international payments process; bill-pay mentions wires 'in more currencies' but this refers to vendor payments, not employee reimbursements. Missing for 10: any mention of multi-currency employee reimbursement, FX handling for expense payouts, or international reimbursement workflow.
